lines.english: "Alright, the reservation orders for lunch are finished. What's left on your end?"
"Eh? Ah, there's two more jambalayas and a lunch set…"
"…There's not a lot left, then. You can take a break, Honda. I'll take it from here."
"Eh? Can I really?"
"We didn't get as many orders as expected, so Satou and I should be able to manage from here."
"So you didn't leave me out of your calculations…"
"It's common sense for the acting manager to rest last. In fact, you should be thankful that you even have breaks."
"I'm not even second-in-command, let alone the acting manager…"
"But you've even gone as far as to take the evening shift in my place, Kitahara-san."
"It's fine. My plans for the end of the year have been canceled anyway."
"Well, excuse me, then. I'll be taking my break now."
"Yeah, good work."
"G-Good work."
"Well then, the afternoon rush is still going to last for about another hour, huh… Let's finish this quickly."
"…Yeah."
Despite having only slept for five hours in the past 40 hours, it's more than enough to charge up my stamina.
After all, I'm now calm enough that I can properly sleep again, and my body can now take some well-needed rest.
"Don't look so dissatisfied. You can rest during the next break before me."
"No, I'm not all that concerned about that."
"Is that so? I feel as if you've been giving me a rather cold look since a while ago."
"No, it wasn't a cold stare."
My return to work after canceling my time off for the end of the year was welcomed in a relatively warm manner by all the staff members.
Though I suppose that's because they can't really complain about having an old, valuable veteran of a staff member provide an extra pair of hands during the intense year-end shift.
"Hey, Kitahara-san."
"What is it?"
In any case, I'm grateful that I can go all out at work from the beginning of the day…
I'll be setting a specific goal for myself every hour, and I'll be evaluating myself based on how I perform.

If I manage to achieve my goal, I'll feel the satisfaction and exhaustion from completing it; if I don't, however, I'll reflect on myself, make sure I won't repeat my mistakes, and work harder for the next hour.
"There's something I wanted to ask…"
"Ask while moving your hands. I won't listen if they stop."
"I know. This skill has been drilled into me by you so much that I'm getting sick of it."
There are two advantages to working like this.
Not only am I able to keep track of my progress, I can focus on my objective and not have to think about anything unnecessary.
"About what happened three days ago… you know, the day when you ended up getting extremely mad at me when we were about to head home and left the whole thing up in the air…"
"Sorry about that! What's wrong with being strict with men? We're men after all!"
"Oh no, I'm not bothered by that anymore, you know. I wouldn't be able to keep working at this restaurant if I let you get on my nerves every time you get mad at me."
"Like I said, have I not apologized for that…?"
He's quite intolerant despite the post he's assigned to…
"Do you remember why you got so mad at me back then?"
"…Two jambalayas and a pork chop are ready."
"You're trying to dodge the question by working even quicker, aren't you?"
"I'm doing nothing of the sort…"
"In the first place, weren't you relieved of your year-end shift because Sugiura-san insisted on it, Kitahara-san?"
"Nothing's wrong with that, right? Even Sugiura agreed to let me come to work starting today anyway."
"No, that's exactly what I don't understand. She was extremely forceful in that regard back then…"
"Acting manager! There's something I need you for! Right now!"
"…You know, like so."
"You should head over quickly, Acting Manager. She's calling for you."
Sugiura's "assistance" arrives at the slightest moment later than the perfect time.
This is to be expected, though; she's made a promise with me, after all.
"Answer within five seconds after you're called! That's what the training manual specifically says, right?"
"U-Understood! Please wait a moment～!"
She promised she would protect me.
"Please think about the way you're treating your subordinates. Sooner or later you're going to be promoted to branch manager, Acting Manager Satou."
"I feel as if my ranking in this restaurant has finally dropped below 4th place…"
"Anyway, try not to pry into Senpai's affairs unnecessarily. All the same, do make the effort to strike some casual conversation with him."
"That's really contradictory…"
"Just make some small talk with him. Talk about things like entertainment, literature, arts, sports, fashion, nature…"
"Uh-huh…"
"However, I ask that you strictly avoid talking about your love lives."
"Is Kitahara-san having trouble with women or something?"
"I didn't mention so much as a single word that would suggest that, did I!?"
"No, you didn't, but…"
"I haven't heard anything like that. It's just that he doesn't look so well, so I'm unnecessarily worrying about him."
"So you yourself think it's unnecessary…"
"In any case, I don't know anything. Well, I am a little concerned, but his relationships with other women have nothing to do with me."
"…Well, in that case, I could just casually ask him about it."
"Please make no attempt to do that. What in the world are you thinking, attempting to step into Senpai's affairs while casting me aside like this?"
"This doesn't feel like I'm talking to a subordinate at all…"
She's a little overprotective, though.
"You really let me see something amazing today…"
"What are you talking about?"
"I have never seen anyone spoil Kitahara-san before, or at least not in this restaurant…"
"Isn't it natural to nurse someone who's not feeling well, no matter how much you dislike them?"
"This is the first time I heard someone other than Kitahara-san say something like that…"
"…Anyway, there's absolutely nothing going on between Senpai and me like you seem to think. I'm sorry for disappointing you."
"During times like this, aren't you supposed to go all red and say, 'I-It's not like I like him or anything!' in an attempt to hide your embarrassment?"
"This isn't a Shoujo manga…"
"Mmnn～ You're no fun, Koharucchi. You could have given me a more innocent reaction."
"Please don't refer to me in such a nonsensical way. Iiyama-san also addressed me that way before, but I see now that you were the one behind it?"
"It's because I've been telling the others about these things that everyone's able to feel familiar with you. You could at least be a little grateful for that…"
"I don't plan to get along with everyone in my workplace."
"Wouldn't it be better to get along with everyone, especially since it's your workplace? Well, I guess that's too hard for you to understand, Koharucchi."
"…If you say that, then what about Kitahara-senpai?"
"He never goes out of his way to get close to anyone, but he isn't really averse when others want to get close to each other, you know?"
"You're avoiding the question, aren't you? You've intentionally left out something, have you not?"
"Hm? What do you mean?"
"He never goes out of his way to get close to anyone. He isn't really averse when others want to get close to each other, either. …Then what if someone wants to get close to him?"
"Hmm…"
"Tanicchi-san, was it? Wasn't she trying her best to get close to Senpai? And what happened then?"
"Well… you know?"
"Let me ask again. How can you explain the situation with Kitahara-senpai, given what you just said?"
"The wound Senpai received is much deeper than we could imagine. Although it's hard to notice because he's usually gloomy to begin with."
"I suppose it's just that I'm a little more aware about that fact than everyone else somehow."
"You'll nurse someone when they're not feeling well, right? Accordingly, is it not natural to want to tend to someone when there's pain in their heart?"
"But you just had to jump to love and affection… I hate simple thinking like that. Senpai isn't just a man to me, he's a perso… ah."
"…What's wrong? Please continue."
"…You planned this, didn't you?"
"What are you talking about?"
"You set me up, didn't you? Your little charade earlier… You intentionally said something incorrect so that I would retort and accidentally say something stupid."
"You really are smart, Koharucchi. That's the first time someone actually saw through my trap."
"Respecting someone as a person is also a form of love, right? And pitying someone is also a form of affection, is it not?"
"…I'll be leaving now."
"Is Kitahara-san not waiting for you at the Bonanza across the street?"
"Unfortunately, I have something else I need to do today… I have an important meeting alone with a guy."
"You don't mind me tattling on you to Kitahara-san, do you?"
"Be my guest. It's not like there's anything between us."
"So, what's the situation?"
"Hmm, well… She only talked to Io on the phone, so we still don't know the details."
"That's fine. Even the slightest detail we have can be really valuable right now."
"If we are to take her words at face value, there's nothing. She just said 'nothing happened,' and no more than that."
"Nothing happened…"
"See? It doesn't tell you anything, right?"
"So, was there anything else that you gathered other than what she said?"
"Hmm?"
"Beating around the bush like this means that there's still something you haven't said, right?"
"…She sounded happy."
"And besides her tone?"
"Do all people start to speak in riddles when they become university students? …I really don't like that, to be honest."
"You must have a knack for conversations like these if you've managed to see through me immediately."
"How is Ogiso-senpai doing? That's all I want to ask."
"…At the very least, I think Setsuna-chan is blaming herself for this."
"I think there's a disconnect between them. One that's much worse than anything that's happened between them up until now."
"What do you mean, 'much worse'…?"
"Haruki has always been the one running away, but this time it seems like it's the other way around…"
"Why…? Didn't you say that both of them still have feelings for each other…"
"That hasn't changed. I have no doubt about it."
"Then…"
"However… that's not all there is to it. There's more to what happened between those two within the past three years."
"That's all I know for now. Now it's your turn."
"What did Haruki say?"
"Who knows?"
"…Huh?"
"I didn't ask him anyway. I promised him that I wouldn't ask anything."
"…What did you say?"
"If Senpai wants to talk about it, I'll be there. That's the promise we made."
"W-When did that happen…?"
"Who knows?"
"Didn't you say you would do anything to make him talk? You were even so confident about him being obliged to tell you everything, given how you were the one who set all this up…"
"I changed my mind."
"In the blink of an eye…"
"Ah, there's something else that I should make clear…"
"W-What is it?"
"I'll have you know that even if Senpai did happen to explain everything to me, whether I'm willing to talk to you two about it is a different matter entirely, Iizuka-senpai."
"…What are you talking about?"
"Dealing with Senpai as he is right now is a bit difficult…"
"Are things… really that bad on his end?"
"What I want to say is, even if you're his close friend from high school, I'd like you to avoid doing anything that would hurt him from now on."
"W-Wait a minute! How could I ever do anything that would hurt Haruki?"
"…Is that so?"
"You said so yourself just now, right? Io and I have known Haruki for over six years…"
"You've been friends with Ogiso-senpai for a long time too, right?"
"Eh…"
"That's why you don't want to hurt her either, right, Iizuka-senpai?"
"W-Well, isn't that obvious…?"
"In that case, when the time comes when you have to choose which side you're on, wouldn't you have a hard time deciding between them?"
"Wha…"
"This isn't a problem for me, though… After all, I've had no interactions with Ogiso-senpai whatsoever."
"Y-You…"
"There should be at least one person siding with him… Though I might be even more unreliable than some court-appointed attorney."
"What's the matter? Did I say something weird?"
"Iizuka-senpai?"
"No… that's enough."
"What do you mean?"
"Don't get involved in this matter any further."
"…What are you saying all of a sudden?"
"Just leave the rest of this to us. Don't worry, those two will definitely make up."
"What's wrong with you? You're acting weird all of a sudden."
"You're the one… who's weird…"
"It's my fault, is it not? I've done nothing but back them into a corner because of my shortsighted plan…"
"But didn't you do that with his best interest in mind? You don't need to feel guilty about it, Koharu-chan."
"It's not because I feel guilty about it, it's that I have a responsibility to help him get back on his feet."
"That's why I told you to leave it to us."
"I won't accept that under any circumstance. I'll take responsibility for my own actions."
"I won't back off, you know?"
"Ah, Io?"
"Yeah, yeah… that's right, it's about them."
"I've realized it'll be really bad if we don't act quickly. Things will take a turn for the worse if we don't patch them up immediately…"
"Eh? Ah, no. I still haven't contacted Haruki."
"Why, you ask… well…"
"You know, Io…"
"I… think I might have made a fatal error in judgement."
